answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 49957 Country: United States of America Title: Nafl Fasting Question: If I skip (unintentionally) sehri of nafl fast, will the fasting be valid? Answer ID: 49957 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 249/203/B=02/1435) Yes, your sawm (fast) will be perfectly valid. It is mustahab practice to get up before Fajr time and to have sehri, it is not wajib or fardh which if missed may affect the validity of sawm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
